evidence.title: OpenMotion — Build launch videos from a prompt

name: OpenMotion
summary: Desktop app that turns a prompt into editable motion scenes on a canvas and timeline, exportable as video, transparent WebM or HTML.
description: OpenMotion generates a scene plan from a chat prompt, then lets you refine composition, timing, easing, colors, assets and sound on a real canvas and timeline before exporting. It is designed to work with a Claude Code or Codex subscription instead of separate API keys, and currently has one free plan while the app is in development.
contains: scene-based canvas with layer and audio timeline
exports: video, transparent WebM, self-contained HTML
works with Claude Code and Codex subscriptions
free while in development; a Pro plan may come later
macOS (Apple silicon/Intel) and Windows 10+ (beta); v1.1.0, 326 MB
